# `aitbc reputation metrics`

Get overall reputation system metrics and level distribution.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc reputation metrics [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc reputation metrics
```
